premises.text: Chronic unpredictable blackouts in places like Nigeria force households and businesses into costly backup generation and daily disruption
premises.evidence_span: it costs four times the amount to run a backup generator than it costs to get power from the grid

premises.text: Low-cost Android phones in proprietary cases act as community power sensors that push outage/restore notifications (and SMS for non-smartphones)
premises.evidence_span: we take low-cost Android phones, just like this, and we turn them into power sensors to let our users know when there's power available in their community

premises.text: Users can report infrastructure issues (e.g., downed lines) to the power company from the app
premises.evidence_span: right within the app, she can go ahead and report that to the power company

premises.text: Primary customers are power companies using the platform for customer communication, with a pilot at Ibaden Power Company
premises.evidence_span: our main customers are the power companies, and they can use our platform to communicate directly with their customers

premises.text: Future monetization includes in-app bill pay/receive and a data play atop the communications platform
premises.evidence_span: we're also looking at how we can have our users pay for their power bills as well as receive their power bills within the app. And of course, there's a data play as well

value.text: Real-time power outage/availability notifications so users and utilities can adapt with more predictability
value.evidence_span: We provide real-time power outage notifications

causal_links.evidence_span: imagine what businesses could adapt to with a little more predictability
she'll get a push notification that the power has been restored
they can use our platform to communicate directly with their customers

notes: Household disruption list (cook/charge/iron/AC/TV) folded into blackout pain-bundle with generator cost. Sensor hardware + push/SMS notifications treated as one sensing/comms mechanism; in-app outage reporting split as distinct user action path. Market-size and phone-penetration figures excluded. Anti-template note: problem, product, and utility GTM/monetization asserted as separately revisable.
